notes.title: Unstable Build 14 - Important
notes.content:
Unstable Build 14 is available through Steam Beta program.

!!! Please use Unstable Build 14 if you want to have Lounge compability with upcoming builds. However, please do keep in mind, game breaking bugs might be present. Not all features intended for build 14 are still in the build, so more are to come.

Current changelog (Subject to Change):

General:
- Network optimization.
- Physics optimization.
- Save file formatting rehauled designed for as much compability as possible with future updates.
- Heavy file size optimization as well as seperate files for terrain and lounge data. This means faster loading, less downloading.
- Physics detection change, objects should not fall through ground anymore.
- Water visual improvement.
- Made most of the small plant objects uncollidable, thus being able to walk through them.
- Added a button in main menu to lead to the Item Store from where players can support developers directly.
- Fixed the placement preview appearing outside the editor.
- Fixed the terrain shaping preview appearing outside the editor.
- Added more tips for the loading screen.
- Matchmaking wont display Lounges with different versions.

Editor:
- Added a gray grid going over X and Z axis.
- Added Undo and Redo for past 50 actions. CTRL + Z to undo and CTRL + Y to redo. It's eligable for following actions:
Spawn Entity, Delete Entities, Duplicate Entities and Entity parameter applying
- Added Entity inspection window. Click one more time on an Entity while it's selected and modify it's parameters without destroying it and making another one. Also a possibility for copying it's parameters from one entity to another.
- Duplicating objects will now move them to position of mouse cursor.
- Changed entity visualization featuring entity icon and it's facing direction.
- New Scene Gizmo that replaces an old one. Pressing on it's axis will change the camera perspective to an according axis.
- Object Selection tool now features options to choose between local and global positioning gizmo. Very useful for light entity!

- Fixed the terrain shaping preview appearing outside the editor.

notes.title: Regarding Next Update
notes.content:
Next Update will make old Lounge saves uncompatible with newer build that's coming out soon. (14)

This is required to change how the Lounge gets saved and loaded. New format decreases the size of Lounges almost by 6 times. This will make loading into Lounges way faster and general loading faster.

There's also some other good stuff coming in the update, one of which is super-wanted feature by the community... good 'ol CTRL + Z

notes.title: Build 13
notes.content:
General:
- NAT Punchthrough functionality testing. This is automatic and should help people behind firewalls to connect. After direct connect failure on the first time, NAT Punchthrough will be used to try establish connection between host and client.
- When subscribing to Lounges on Steam Workshop it's no longer necassary to restart the game. After the Lounge will get downloaded through Steam Client, the list of Workshops will be updated.
- Uploading Lounges to workshop will now show progress.
- Player head faces the direction which player actually looks at.
- Shadow tweaks, this one needs a bit more tweaking, but it looks a bit better.
- VSync option unlocked.
- When connecting to Lounge the download progress will be shown in megabytes.
- Animations are now syncronized locally. This needs to be improved a bit more, but already gives better net and local perfomance.

Editor:
- New Primitive Objects! 
- Added directional light possibility to Light Entity. Use rotation to direct it in needed position.
- Stairs removed for a while..
- Fixed Lights not loading properly in the Editor.

tags.feature: - New Primitive Objects!
- Added directional light possibility to Light Entity. Use rotation to direct it in needed position.

tags.bug: - Fixed Lights not loading properly in the Editor.

notes.title: Build 11 - About damn time
notes.content:
Okay, it's been a long time and I'm sorry. Hopefully what's in the new update will be okay after such long pause and especially how I used to do frequent patches.

Anyway, lets get to the main features. I can't remember everything what's in there so I'll go through most important parts:

LOUNGE TERRAIN:
- New structure, allows more detail and looks prettier itself.
- Resizable.
- No need to preview low-poly anymore, changes are immediate.
- Optimization for when sculpting, smaller FPS drops.

LOUNGE GENERAL:
- UI change, should be easier for eyes with less orange and white colors blending.
- Entities:

Spawnpoints. Previously you could only have one spawnpoint, now you can have several of them on Lounge and when spawning player will go to the random one of those.

Lights. Now you can have lights in your Lounge, however keep in mind that they are a bit perfomance invasive, so try to use them sparingly.

GENERAL:
- Distant fog that blends with sky to make smooth blend in further distances.
- Workshop support for Lounges. You can now upload Lounges and play Lounges uploaded by other people.

That's the main features for now. There's one more Christmas update coming up quite soon, sorry once again and enjoy festive season!

Spawnpoints. Previously you could only have one spawnpoint, now you can have several of them on Lounge and when spawning player will go to the random one of those.
Lights. Now you can have lights in your Lounge, however keep in mind that they are a bit perfomance invasive, so try to use them sparingly.
- Distant fog that blends with sky to make smooth blend in further distances.
- Workshop support for Lounges. You can now upload Lounges and play Lounges uploaded by other people.

notes.title: Regarding Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Next update will be focused on Lounge Editor and it will have some incompabilities with older saves. 

The way terrain works will be changed and it wont load up in the old Lounges after the update, but everything else should be fine and old Lounges should still load up, however the terrain will be reverted to new default.

This new update will allow custom terrain sizes and also bigger partitioning allowing more detail to be shown on the terrain.

Sorry for the inconvienence, if you've got any more questions regarding the upcoming update let me know.

tags.feature: This new update will allow custom terrain sizes and also bigger partitioning allowing more detail to be shown on the terrain.

notes.title: Project Lounge - Build 3
notes.content:
BUILD 3:

- New Lobby/Lounge selection.
- Discord Server Button in the main menu Header. Come and join our Discord Server! :D
- Voice chat indicator now animates when talking on client-side.
- New Voice chat indicator above heads to see who's using microphone.
- Increased player cap from 8 to 12.
- Made Achievements show their completion right after you do it.
- Possibly fixed an error with picking up a non permitted item.
- When chat gets more than 50 messages, it starts cleaning up the oldest messages when new ones come.
- Added possibility to retry forward ports in-game by pressing on Firewall image.
- Fixed Privacy Settings from inside the game to actually apply.
- Added error when trying to enter Lobby with wrong settings.

If you encounter bugs, please type them inside Community Hub discussions :)
